archetypes.name: retry-budget
archetypes.rationale: Independent auth and transient budgets are the core behavior change.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Codex and Cursor health probe retry loops for off-by-one errors and budget coupling. Check auth attempt-cap semantics, transient retry-after-first-failure semantics, timeout handling, and explicit LARCH_PROBE_RETRIES override behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: health-fastfail
archetypes.rationale: Health-gate and auth-preflight fast-fail paths must not regress latency.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the check_reviewers call-site wiring for health-gate compatibility and Cursor preflight auth failures. Verify deterministic setup failures and preflight auth paths cannot consume transient retry budget. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
